section.h2: Stargazers over the last two weeks

div.div:
Discovered issue:
When react-router-dom is built the entire website needs to be redirected to the index.html file. This is not currently happening The website currently thinks that all urls are actual files and it is trying to find the non-existent files resulting in a 404 error on the client
How to fix:
Change config either on JustHost or in .htaccess file to rewrite all urls to the index.html file for react-router-dom to handle
